description: Marketing campaigns, launch copy, blog posts, newsletters, social media, and SEO content.

brief_fields.description: Primary campaign objective (e.g. product launch, lead gen, brand awareness).
Target audience segment — who the content is written for.
Distribution channels in scope (e.g. blog, email, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, press).
Brand voice and tone guidelines (e.g. authoritative, conversational, playful).
Top-line messages that every piece must reinforce.
Primary call-to-action the campaign drives toward.
